selected_skill.selection_reason: Recurring billing, invoice handling, tax calculation, current-cycle adjustments, failed-payment routing, and usage-based charges map directly to a renewal batch processor implementation task.

safe_use_screening.notes: The task uses task-local code and task-local data shaped from public payment references. It avoids outside billing workspaces, customer credentials, and payout or refund operations.

real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Use public Stripe-style field shapes for plans, subscriptions, invoices, usage, and policy rules, then compose a deterministic local billing batch with licensed, metered, manual-invoice, payment-method, retry, pause, and current-cycle adjustment cases.
real_data_design.determinism: All inputs live inside the task. The verifier recomputes expected rows from the same local files and can run shadow batches against temporary mutated copies of the data.

environment_design.editable_workspace: Starter implementation under /root/app with incomplete amount and action logic.
environment_design.with_without_control: with_skill and without_skill differ only by whether environment/skills is present in the runtime copy and copied into the agent skill path.

goals: State the implementation contract clearly: complete the batch processor and produce two outputs.
Keep output fields explicit while avoiding step-by-step solver instructions.
Leave the policy precedence and calculation details in data and code rather than spelling them out in the prompt.
hidden_workflow_pressure: The current-cycle adjustment uses remaining-period proration and can be positive or negative.
Manual-invoice, retry, missing-payment-method, and collection-exhausted cases must be routed in the correct priority order.
Shadow-run tests mutate usage and quantity-change inputs so hardcoded outputs and fixture-only logic fail.

main_tests: required output files exist and parse
billing action rows exactly match recomputed batch decisions
summary totals, action counts, and blocked subscription ids recompute from the same decision set
row evidence fields contain auditable record identifiers
guardrails: no extra top-level output files are produced
shadow data mutations change renewal and adjustment amounts in the correct direction
verifier_design.failure_target: without_skill should fail for action-level reasons such as misrouting exhausted collections, omitting current-cycle adjustments, missing metered charges in renewal totals, or hardcoding outputs that fail shadow runs.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial uses a new isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and comparison trials are available.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence and corresponding copy behavior. Experimental reminder text, when used, stays only in runtime copies.
